tools.name: return_stats
tools.title: Return statistics
tools.description: Summarize a return series: periods, annualized geometric return (CAGR) and volatility, Sharpe, max drawdown, skew, excess kurtosis, best and worst period, share positive.
tools.keywords: summary describe cagr volatility overview
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, risk_free?: number

tools.name: sharpe_ratio
tools.title: Sharpe ratio with standard error
tools.description: Compute the annualized Sharpe ratio with its standard error and 95% interval, under iid normal returns (Lo 2002) and allowing skew and fat tails (Mertens 2002). For the probability it beats luck across many trials, use canli-validation-mcp.
tools.keywords: sharpe risk-adjusted lo mertens confidence interval
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, risk_free?: number

tools.name: sortino_ratio
tools.title: Sortino ratio
tools.description: Compute the annualized Sortino ratio: mean return above a target over downside deviation below it, with the downside deviation itself.
tools.keywords: sortino downside deviation target mar
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, target?: number

tools.name: max_drawdown
tools.title: Drawdowns
tools.description: Find the maximum drawdown and the worst drawdown episodes: depth, peak, trough, recovery and length in periods, plus time under water.
tools.keywords: drawdown peak trough recovery underwater episodes
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, top?: integer, dates?: string[]

tools.name: calmar_ratio
tools.title: Calmar ratio
tools.description: Compute the Calmar ratio: annualized geometric return over the absolute maximum drawdown of the whole series.
tools.keywords: calmar drawdown return mar ratio
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number

tools.name: omega_ratio
tools.title: Omega ratio
tools.description: Compute the Omega ratio at a threshold: the sum of gains above it over the sum of losses below it.
tools.keywords: omega gain loss threshold
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, threshold?: number

tools.name: value_at_risk
tools.title: Value at risk
tools.description: Estimate value at risk as a positive loss fraction: historical, Gaussian and Cornish-Fisher (skew and kurtosis adjusted), over one or more periods.
tools.keywords: var value-at-risk cornish-fisher parametric historical tail loss
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, confidence?: number, horizon?: integer

tools.name: expected_shortfall
tools.title: Expected shortfall (CVaR)
tools.description: Estimate expected shortfall (CVaR): the average loss beyond value at risk, historical and Gaussian, as a positive loss fraction.
tools.keywords: cvar expected shortfall conditional var tail
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, confidence?: number, horizon?: integer

tools.name: capm_regression
tools.title: Alpha and beta (CAPM)
tools.description: Regress excess returns on benchmark excess returns: beta, alpha (annualized), their t-stats and p-values, R-squared, correlation and residual (idiosyncratic) volatility.
tools.keywords: alpha beta capm regression market jensen
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, benchmark: number[], risk_free?: number

tools.name: information_ratio
tools.title: Information ratio and tracking error
tools.description: Compute active return, tracking error and the information ratio of a strategy against its benchmark, annualized.
tools.keywords: information ratio tracking error active return benchmark relative
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, benchmark: number[]

tools.name: treynor_ratio
tools.title: Treynor ratio
tools.description: Compute the Treynor ratio: annualized excess return per unit of beta to the benchmark.
tools.keywords: treynor beta systematic risk
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, benchmark: number[], risk_free?: number

tools.name: m2_measure
tools.title: Modigliani M-squared
tools.description: Compute Modigliani's M-squared: the return the strategy would have earned levered to the benchmark's volatility, and its difference from the benchmark.
tools.keywords: m2 modigliani risk-adjusted return
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, benchmark: number[], risk_free?: number

tools.name: capture_ratios
tools.title: Up and down capture
tools.description: Compute up-market and down-market capture: the strategy's annualized return in benchmark up periods and down periods, relative to the benchmark's.
tools.keywords: upside downside capture ratio
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, benchmark: number[]

tools.name: ulcer_index
tools.title: Ulcer index and Martin ratio
tools.description: Compute the Ulcer index (root-mean-square drawdown), the Martin (ulcer performance) ratio, and the pain index and pain ratio (mean drawdown).
tools.keywords: ulcer martin pain index drawdown depth duration
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, risk_free?: number

tools.name: drawdown_at_risk
tools.title: Conditional drawdown at risk
tools.description: Estimate drawdown at risk (a drawdown quantile across periods) and conditional drawdown at risk (the mean drawdown beyond it), as positive fractions.
tools.keywords: cdar dar conditional drawdown at risk
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, confidence?: number

tools.name: tail_ratio
tools.title: Tail and Rachev ratios
tools.description: Compute the tail ratio (95th percentile return over the absolute 5th) and the Rachev ratio (mean of the best tail over the mean loss of the worst tail).
tools.keywords: tail ratio rachev skew asymmetry
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, tail?: number

tools.name: gain_to_pain
tools.title: Gain-to-pain ratio
tools.description: Compute Schwager's gain-to-pain ratio: the sum of returns over the absolute sum of losing returns.
tools.keywords: gain pain schwager
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number

tools.name: trade_stats
tools.title: Trade statistics
tools.description: Summarize closed-trade results: win rate, profit factor, payoff ratio, expectancy, largest win and loss, and longest winning and losing streaks.
tools.keywords: trades win rate profit factor payoff expectancy streak
tools.args: pnl: number[]

tools.name: kelly_fraction
tools.title: Kelly fraction
tools.description: Compute the growth-optimal (Kelly) fraction: from a return series (continuous, (mean - rf) / variance), or from a win probability and payoff odds. Also gives half Kelly.
tools.keywords: kelly sizing optimal fraction leverage bet
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, risk_free?: number, win_probability?: number, payoff?: number

tools.name: autocorrelation
tools.title: Autocorrelation and Ljung-Box
tools.description: Test a return series for serial correlation: autocorrelations at each lag and the Ljung-Box Q statistic with its p-value.
tools.keywords: autocorrelation acf ljung-box serial correlation independence
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, lags?: integer

tools.name: normality_test
tools.title: Normality (Jarque-Bera)
tools.description: Test whether returns are normal with the Jarque-Bera test, with skew and excess kurtosis.
tools.keywords: jarque-bera normal distribution fat tails skew kurtosis
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number

tools.name: autocorrelation_adjusted_sharpe
tools.title: Sharpe adjusted for autocorrelation
tools.description: Annualize a Sharpe ratio allowing for serial correlation (Lo 2002): smoothed or autocorrelated returns overstate the usual sqrt(time) Sharpe.
tools.keywords: lo 2002 autocorrelation sharpe annualization smoothing hedge fund
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, risk_free?: number, max_lag?: integer

tools.name: rolling_sharpe
tools.title: Rolling Sharpe summary
tools.description: Summarize the rolling Sharpe ratio over a window: latest, min, max, median and the share of windows below zero; shows whether performance is stable or decaying.
tools.keywords: rolling window sharpe stability decay
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, window?: integer, risk_free?: number

tools.name: black_scholes
tools.title: Black-Scholes price and Greeks
tools.description: Price a European option under Black-Scholes-Merton with a dividend yield, with delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho, vanna, volga, charm, speed and the risk-neutral probability of finishing in the money.
tools.keywords: call put vanilla value fair price black scholes merton bsm option price greeks delta gamma vega theta rho european
tools.args: type: call|put, spot: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number, volatility: number

tools.name: implied_volatility
tools.title: Implied volatility
tools.description: Solve for the Black-Scholes-Merton implied volatility of a European option from its price, refusing prices outside no-arbitrage bounds.
tools.keywords: implied volatility iv solve option price invert
tools.args: type: call|put, spot: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number, price: number

tools.name: black76
tools.title: Black-76 (options on futures)
tools.description: Price a European option on a futures or forward with Black-76, with delta, gamma and vega; also used for caps, floors and swaptions on a forward rate.
tools.keywords: black 76 futures forward option commodity cap floor swaption
tools.args: type: call|put, forward: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, volatility: number

tools.name: bachelier
tools.title: Bachelier (normal model)
tools.description: Price a European option under the Bachelier normal model, which allows negative forwards (rates, spreads), with delta, gamma and vega.
tools.keywords: bachelier normal model negative rates spread option
tools.args: type: call|put, forward: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, normal_volatility: number

tools.name: american_option
tools.title: American option (binomial tree)
tools.description: Price an American option with a dividend yield (binomial Black-Scholes with Richardson extrapolation), with the European price and the early-exercise premium.
tools.keywords: american option binomial tree crr early exercise
tools.args: type: call|put, spot: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number, volatility: number, steps?: integer

tools.name: digital_option
tools.title: Digital (binary) option
tools.description: Price a European cash-or-nothing or asset-or-nothing digital option under Black-Scholes-Merton, with delta.
tools.keywords: digital binary cash or nothing asset or nothing
tools.args: type: call|put, payout?: cash|asset, spot: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number, volatility: number

tools.name: put_call_parity
tools.title: Put-call parity check
tools.description: Check put-call parity for a European pair: the parity gap, the implied forward and the implied rate-minus-yield, to spot mispricing or stale quotes.
tools.keywords: put call parity arbitrage forward conversion reversal
tools.args: call: number, put: number, spot: number, strike: number, years: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number

tools.name: option_strategy_payoff
tools.title: Multi-leg strategy payoff
tools.description: Evaluate a multi-leg options position at expiry (calls, puts, underlying): net premium, payoff and profit at chosen prices, breakevens, and maximum profit and loss.
tools.keywords: strategy payoff spread straddle strangle butterfly condor collar covered call breakeven expiry
tools.args: legs: {type,strike,quantity,premium}[], prices?: number[]

tools.name: option_portfolio_greeks
tools.title: Portfolio Greeks
tools.description: Aggregate Black-Scholes-Merton Greeks across many option positions on one underlying: net delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho and the dollar delta and gamma.
tools.keywords: portfolio greeks aggregate book risk delta hedge
tools.args: spot: number, rate?: number, dividend_yield?: number, positions: {type,strike,years,volatility,quantity,multiplier}[]

tools.name: volatility_conversions
tools.title: Volatility conversions
tools.description: Convert volatility between periods and forms: annual to daily, weekly or monthly, the expected move over a horizon, and lognormal to approximate normal (basis point) volatility.
tools.keywords: volatility convert annualize daily expected move straddle normal lognormal bp
tools.args: annual_volatility: number, level?: number, days?: number, trading_days?: number

tools.name: vix_style_index
tools.title: Model-free implied volatility (VIX method)
tools.description: Compute a VIX-style model-free implied volatility from option chains with the CBOE method: forward from put-call parity, out-of-the-money strips with the two-zero-bid cutoff, per-expiry variance, and interpolation to a constant maturity (30 days by default).
tools.keywords: vix model free implied volatility variance swap fair strike cboe method volatility index option chain 30 day
tools.args: near: {minutes_to_expiry,rate,options}, next?: {minutes_to_expiry,rate,options}, days?: number

tools.name: risk_neutral_density
tools.title: Risk-neutral density from option prices
tools.description: Recover the market's risk-neutral distribution from call prices across strikes (Breeden-Litzenberger): density and cumulative probability at each strike, its mean, volatility, skewness and kurtosis, probabilities beyond chosen levels, and strikes where the density is negative (butterfly arbitrage).
tools.keywords: risk neutral density breeden litzenberger implied distribution option implied probability butterfly arbitrage skew
tools.args: strikes: number[], call_prices: number[], years: number, rate?: number, levels?: number[]

tools.name: sma
tools.title: Simple moving average
tools.description: Compute the simple moving average of closing prices over a lookback.
tools.keywords: sma simple moving average ma trend
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: ema
tools.title: Exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the exponential moving average (seeded with the simple average, as TA-Lib does).
tools.keywords: ema exponential moving average trend smoothing
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: wma
tools.title: Weighted moving average
tools.description: Compute the linearly weighted moving average (latest price weighted most).
tools.keywords: wma weighted moving average linear
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: dema
tools.title: Double exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the double exponential moving average (2 EMA - EMA of EMA), which lags less than an EMA.
tools.keywords: dema double exponential moving average lag
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: tema
tools.title: Triple exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the triple exponential moving average (3 EMA - 3 EMA2 + EMA3).
tools.keywords: tema triple exponential moving average
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: hull_moving_average
tools.title: Hull moving average
tools.description: Compute the Hull moving average, WMA(2 WMA(n/2) - WMA(n), sqrt n), a fast, smooth trend line.
tools.keywords: hull moving average hma fast smooth
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: kama
tools.title: Kaufman adaptive moving average
tools.description: Compute Kaufman's adaptive moving average, which speeds up in trends and slows in noise (efficiency ratio, fast 2, slow 30).
tools.keywords: kama kaufman adaptive moving average efficiency ratio
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: rsi
tools.title: Relative strength index
tools.description: Compute Wilder's relative strength index (0-100): above 70 often read as overbought, below 30 as oversold.
tools.keywords: rsi relative strength index momentum overbought oversold wilder
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: macd
tools.title: MACD
tools.description: Compute MACD (fast EMA - slow EMA), its signal line and histogram, as TA-Lib does.
tools.keywords: macd moving average convergence divergence signal histogram momentum
tools.args: close: number[], fast?: integer, slow?: integer, signal?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: bollinger_bands
tools.title: Bollinger Bands
tools.description: Compute Bollinger Bands: a moving average with bands k population standard deviations above and below, plus %B and bandwidth.
tools.keywords: bollinger bands volatility bands standard deviation percent b bandwidth squeeze
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, deviations?: number, tail?: integer

tools.name: stochastic
tools.title: Stochastic oscillator
tools.description: Compute the slow stochastic oscillator: %K (smoothed position of the close in the high-low range) and %D.
tools.keywords: stochastic oscillator percent k d momentum overbought oversold
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], k_period?: integer, k_smooth?: integer, d_period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: williams_r
tools.title: Williams %R
tools.description: Compute Williams %R (-100 to 0): where the close sits in the recent high-low range.
tools.keywords: williams percent r momentum overbought oversold
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: cci
tools.title: Commodity channel index
tools.description: Compute the commodity channel index: typical price's distance from its average in units of mean absolute deviation.
tools.keywords: cci commodity channel index momentum cyclical
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: atr
tools.title: Average true range
tools.description: Compute Wilder's average true range and its percent of price (NATR), the standard volatility measure for stops and sizing.
tools.keywords: atr average true range volatility stop loss position sizing natr
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: adx
tools.title: Average directional index
tools.description: Compute Wilder's ADX trend strength with +DI and -DI (TA-Lib's smoothing): ADX above 25 is usually read as trending.
tools.keywords: adx average directional index dmi plus minus di trend strength wilder
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: obv
tools.title: On-balance volume
tools.description: Compute on-balance volume, the running sum of volume signed by the close's direction.
tools.keywords: obv on balance volume accumulation
tools.args: close: number[], volume: number[], tail?: integer

tools.name: money_flow_index
tools.title: Money flow index
tools.description: Compute the money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0-100) from typical price and volume.
tools.keywords: mfi money flow index volume rsi
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], volume: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: rate_of_change
tools.title: Rate of change and momentum
tools.description: Compute rate of change (percent change over n bars) and momentum (price difference over n bars).
tools.keywords: roc rate of change momentum percent change
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: trix
tools.title: TRIX
tools.description: Compute TRIX, the one-bar percent change of a triple-smoothed EMA, a filtered momentum oscillator.
tools.keywords: trix triple exponential momentum oscillator
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: aroon
tools.title: Aroon indicator
tools.description: Compute Aroon up and down (0-100: how recently the highest high and lowest low occurred) and the Aroon oscillator.
tools.keywords: aroon up down oscillator trend new highs lows
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: chande_momentum
tools.title: Chande momentum oscillator
tools.description: Compute the Chande momentum oscillator (-100 to 100) with Wilder smoothing, as TA-Lib does.
tools.keywords: cmo chande momentum oscillator
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: ultimate_oscillator
tools.title: Ultimate oscillator
tools.description: Compute Williams' ultimate oscillator, blending buying pressure over three horizons (7, 14, 28 by default).
tools.keywords: ultimate oscillator williams buying pressure
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], short?: integer, medium?: integer, long?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: accumulation_distribution
tools.title: Accumulation/distribution and Chaikin oscillator
tools.description: Compute the Chaikin accumulation/distribution line and the Chaikin oscillator (fast EMA - slow EMA of the line).
tools.keywords: accumulation distribution ad line chaikin oscillator adosc volume
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], volume: number[], fast?: integer, slow?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: donchian_channels
tools.title: Donchian channels
tools.description: Compute Donchian channels: the highest high and lowest low over a lookback and their midpoint (breakout systems).
tools.keywords: donchian channel breakout turtle highest high lowest low
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: keltner_channels
tools.title: Keltner channels
tools.description: Compute Keltner channels: an EMA of the close with bands a multiple of ATR above and below.
tools.keywords: keltner channels atr bands volatility envelope
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], period?: integer, atr_period?: integer, multiplier?: number, tail?: integer

tools.name: vwap
tools.title: Volume-weighted average price
tools.description: Compute the cumulative volume-weighted average price from typical price, or a rolling VWAP over a window.
tools.keywords: vwap volume weighted average price execution benchmark intraday
tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], volume: number[], window?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: ichimoku_cloud
tools.title: Ichimoku cloud
tools.description: Compute the Ichimoku lines: conversion (tenkan), base (kijun), leading spans A and B (shown at the bar they are computed, not shifted forward) and lagging span.

tools.args: high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], conversion?: integer, base?: integer, span_b?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: rolling_zscore
tools.title: Rolling z-score
tools.description: Compute each price's z-score against its rolling mean and sample standard deviation, the basic mean-reversion signal.
tools.keywords: z score rolling standardized mean reversion signal bollinger
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: stochastic_rsi
tools.title: Stochastic RSI
tools.description: Compute the stochastic RSI: where RSI sits in its own recent range (%K, unsmoothed by default as in TA-Lib) and its moving average %D.
tools.keywords: stochastic rsi stoch rsi momentum overbought oversold
tools.args: close: number[], period?: integer, stoch_period?: integer, k_smooth?: integer, d_period?: integer, tail?: integer

tools.name: parabolic_sar
tools.title: Parabolic SAR
tools.description: Compute Wilder's parabolic stop-and-reverse trailing stop with its trend direction (acceleration 0.02 step, 0.2 max by default).
tools.keywords: parabolic sar stop and reverse trailing stop wilder trend

tools.description: Fit ordinary least squares of y on several regressors with classical, heteroskedasticity-robust (HC1) or Newey-West HAC standard errors, R-squared, F-test and AIC.
tools.keywords: linear regression ols least squares newey west hac robust standard errors hc1 multivariate r squared
tools.args: y: number[], x: number[][], names?: string[], constant?: boolean, standard_errors?: classical|hc1|hac, lags?: integer

tools.title: Factor model regression (alpha and betas)

tools.name: mean_reversion_fit
tools.title: Mean reversion (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) fit

tools.title: GARCH(1,1) volatility model

tools.name: ewma_volatility
tools.title: EWMA (RiskMetrics) volatility
tools.description: Compute exponentially weighted volatility (RiskMetrics, lambda 0.94 by default): the current annualized estimate and optionally the full series.
tools.keywords: ewma exponentially weighted moving average volatility riskmetrics lambda decay
tools.args: returns?: number[], prices?: number[], periods_per_year?: number, lambda?: number, include_series?: boolean

tools.name: range_volatility
tools.title: Range-based volatility (OHLC)

tools.keywords: parkinson garman klass rogers satchell yang zhang realized volatility ohlc range estimator high low
tools.args: open: number[], high: number[], low: number[], close: number[], periods_per_year?: number

tools.title: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
tools.description: Compute the probability that the true Sharpe ratio exceeds a benchmark given the track record's length, skewness and kurtosis (Bailey and López de Prado), and the minimum track record length needed. Send the seven statistics or a return series. With every variant's returns use validate_overfitting; luck as a trial count, validate_luck_trials; a multiple-testing haircut, validate_haircut_sharpe. Needs every variant's returns (periods by variants); with summary statistics only, use validate_deflated_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.
tools.args: matrix: number[][], n_splits?: integer, max_combinations?: integer, seed?: number

tools.name: validate_reality_check

tools.args: observed_sharpe_annualized: number, periods_per_year: number, observations: integer, effective_independent_trials?: integer, skew?: number, autocorrelation?: number

tools.description: Find a company's SEC CIK and tickers by name, ticker or CIK. The other tools also take a name as company.
tools.keywords: lookup ticker cik identifier
tools.args: query: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: cross_section
tools.title: Cross-section as of a date
tools.description: Get one measure for up to 50 companies as filed by a date: each one's latest period and its value then (changed_after: true adds whether a filing after the date changed it). For point-in-time peer and factor work.
tools.keywords: compare companies peers screen revenue income many
tools.args: companies: string[], concept: string, as_of: string, periods?: annual|quarterly, changed_after?: boolean

tools.name: search_research
tools.title: Search research
tools.description: Find Canli Capital research papers (strategy tests, killed candidates, literature reviews, feasibility protocols) by words in their titles and summaries. Use it to find a paper's slug, then read it with get_paper; to browse by subject instead, use list_topics.
tools.args: query: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: Research topics
tools.description: The research topics, with how many papers each holds and what it covers.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.title: Read a paper
tools.description: A research paper's text as published, by slug, with its headings; send section for one part, and max_chars to cap the length. Find the slug with search_research or list_topics first.
tools.args: slug: string, section?: string, max_chars?: integer

tools.name: trial_ledger
tools.title: Trial ledger
tools.description: How many distinct hypotheses Canli Capital has tried against its declared budget, and how many were killed or survived. Use it to judge any published result against the size of the search behind it.

tools.name: live_record
tools.title: Live paper record
tools.description: The live paper-trading record (returns, costs, risk, corrections, provenance) and each sleeve's paper equity, with their limits. Use it for how the strategies are doing now; for why they exist, read the papers.

tools.name: chain_head
tools.title: Verification chain head
tools.description: The head of the tamper-evident chain that shows the published record was not rewritten after publication, with where to verify it. Use it to check that a figure you read was not changed later.

tools.name: list_factors
tools.title: Point-in-time factors
tools.description: The point-in-time factors pit_factor builds from SEC filings, and what each measures.

tools.name: pit_factor
tools.title: Build a point-in-time factor
tools.description: Build a factor from SEC filings for a list of tickers, monthly from start to end, using only what had been filed by each date (restatements invisible until filed). Writes a signal CSV for backtest_signal. Values are what companies reported to the SEC in XBRL, as filed by each date; a company that files late, files outside XBRL or changes its tags can be missing.
tools.keywords: build construct make factor value momentum quality from sec filings point in time without lookahead
tools.args: factor: string, tickers: string[], start: string, end: string, out_file?: string

tools.name: backtest_signal
tools.title: Backtest a signal without lookahead
tools.description: Backtest a signal against your prices: rank, long and short quantiles, rebalance, trading only on what was known lag_days earlier, costs on actual trades. Every reply holds the result against the crises its dates cover and lists the ones it does not. With capital_usd and dollar_volume_file, orders fill only as far as the market traded, pay square-root impact, and the reply shows the Sharpe at each size the market can take. Pass ledger to judge the best of a search against all of it. A backtest measures one path of history under these costs; it does not establish that the signal will keep working.
tools.keywords: test my signal csv prices backtest without lookahead
tools.args: prices_file: string, signal_file: string, rebalance?: weekly|monthly|quarterly|integer, lag_days?: integer, side?: long_short|long_only, quantile?: number, cost_bps?: number, min_names?: integer, periods_per_year?: number, capital_usd?: number, dollar_volume_file?: string, max_participation?: number, impact_coefficient?: number, crisis_drawdown_limit?: number, ledger?: string, label?: string

tools.name: proof_filings
tools.title: Add company filings to a proof ledger
tools.description: Add what companies filed to a signed, append-only ledger: each figure with its filing, and a restatement line whenever a later filing changes one. Re-running adds only what is new. It shows the lines were not altered afterwards, not that a figure is right.
tools.args: ledger_file: string, companies: string[], key_file?: string

tools.name: proof_file
tools.title: Record a file in a proof ledger
tools.description: Record a file's hash in a signed, append-only ledger, a backtest result or a returns file, so anyone can later check this exact file existed by then. Nothing else about the file is claimed.
tools.args: ledger_file: string, file: string, label: string, kind?: backtest|returns|league_entry|other, key_file?: string

tools.name: proof_verify
tools.title: Verify a proof ledger
tools.description: Check a proof ledger from the file alone: every hash, order and signature, and any heads published elsewhere. Says which line first fails.
tools.args: ledger_file: string, anchors?: {seq,hash}[]

tools.name: proof_find
tools.title: Look up a proof ledger
tools.description: Look up a file, company or concept in a proof ledger. No record means only that this ledger holds none, not that anything is wrong.
tools.args: ledger_file: string, sha256?: string, file?: string, company?: string, concept?: string, kind?: figure|restatement|file, limit?: integer

tools.name: league_new
tools.title: Start a paper league
tools.description: Start a paper league: a schedule of rounds and rules with a hash to publish. No prizes, no stakes and nobody's money.
tools.args: league_dir: string, name: string, first_close: string, rounds: integer, days_per_round?: integer, min_names?: integer

tools.name: league_commit
tools.title: Commit a league entry
tools.description: Commit a league entry before its round closes: only the hash of its CSV of ticker,score goes in the ledger, and the file is shown after the round. Only the latest commit counts, so revealing whichever of several did best is refused.
tools.args: league_dir: string, round: string, entrant: string, file: string, entrant_key_file: string, key_file?: string

tools.name: league_score
tools.title: Score a paper league
tools.description: Score a paper league from its files and prices, repeatable by anyone: each entrant's rank correlation with what followed, set against the best luck gives across that many entrants, how different each is from the rest, and a paper book of the top entrants chosen on earlier rounds only.
tools.args: league_dir: string, prices_file: string, book_size?: integer

tools.name: exchange_new
tools.title: Start a paper exchange
tools.description: Start a paper exchange where different AI agents and scripted traders (market makers, momentum, value, deleveragers, stop-losses, levered longs) trade in limit order books, with margin rules and forced selling, plus shocks at set steps. Made-up assets and money, reproducible from a seed.
tools.keywords: ai agents trade against each other multi agent simulated order book personas paper market sandbox
tools.args: exchange_file: string, seed?: integer, assets?: integer, personas?: {market_maker,value,momentum,noise,deleverager,stop_loss,levered_long}, starting_cash?: number, maintenance_margin?: number, leverage?: number, shocks?: {step,kind,asset,percent,steps,quantity}[]

tools.name: exchange_join
tools.title: Join a paper exchange
tools.description: Join a paper exchange as an agent. Returns the token its other calls need, so no agent can act as another.
tools.args: exchange_file: string, agent: string, about?: string

tools.name: exchange_view
tools.title: See a paper exchange
tools.description: What an agent in a paper exchange can see: the books, recent trades and its own account. No other agent's positions.
tools.args: exchange_file: string, agent: string, token: string, depth?: integer

tools.name: exchange_orders
tools.title: Send orders to a paper exchange
tools.description: Send an agent's limit orders, market orders and cancels for the coming step of a paper exchange. An empty list passes.
tools.args: exchange_file: string, agent: string, token: string, orders: object[]

tools.name: exchange_step
tools.title: Move a paper exchange on
tools.description: Move a paper exchange on. Waits for every joined agent to act, so nobody moves time on the others.
tools.args: exchange_file: string, steps?: integer, force?: boolean

tools.name: exchange_report
tools.title: Report a paper exchange
tools.description: What happened in a paper exchange: each asset's worst fall and recovery, spreads and depth, who gained and lost, forced selling and the longest chain of it, and a hash anyone can check by replaying.
tools.args: exchange_file: string

tools.name: exchange_run
tools.title: Run a whole paper exchange
tools.description: Run a whole paper exchange of scripted traders in one call and report it: for comparing set-ups, such as how much leverage turns a shock into a cascade. A simulation, not a forecast.
tools.keywords: simulate ai agents trading against each other simulation market cascade flash crash margin calls forced selling limit order book liquidity withdrawal stress
tools.args: seed?: integer, assets?: integer, personas?: {market_maker,value,momentum,noise,deleverager,stop_loss,levered_long}, starting_cash?: number, maintenance_margin?: number, leverage?: number, shocks?: {step,kind,asset,percent,steps,quantity}[], steps: integer

tools.name: agent_consensus
tools.title: Combine agents' forecasts and count independent views
tools.description: Combine several AI agents' probabilities, and count how many independent views they really hold, from how their errors move together: five models that share their mistakes are not five votes. Weights each by its record on settled questions.
tools.keywords: do my models disagree same opinion independent views ensemble of ai models combine forecasts wisdom of crowds
tools.args: agents: {name,forecasts}[], outcomes?: {question,happened}[]

tools.name: find_diversifiers
tools.title: Find what diversifies a book
tools.description: Rank candidate strategies by what they add to a book: independent bets added first, then how they behave on the book's worst days, with return shown last and never used to rank. Correlation first.
tools.keywords: uncorrelated strategies low correlation what should i add to my portfolio book diversify diversifier
tools.args: book_file: string, candidates_file: string, limit?: integer, min_days?: integer

tools.name: arena_new
tools.title: Start a paper arena
tools.description: Start a paper market for AI agents to trade in: made-up assets and made-up money, with scripted traders, reproducible from a seed. Nothing here represents or reaches a real security, token or currency.
tools.args: arena_file: string, seed?: integer, assets?: integer, starting_cash?: number, bots?: integer

tools.name: arena_orders
tools.title: Send paper orders to an arena
tools.description: Send paper orders for an agent in an arena, for the coming auction. No short selling and no borrowing.
tools.args: arena_file: string, agent: string, orders: {asset,side,quantity,limit}[]

tools.name: arena_step
tools.title: Clear a paper arena
tools.description: Clear a paper arena's next call auctions at one price per asset, and show prices and standings. Paper only.
tools.args: arena_file: string, steps?: integer

tools.name: crisis_replay
tools.title: Replay strategies through named crises
tools.description: Hold any strategy's daily returns against named market crises (2000-02 dot-com bust, 2008-09 bank crisis, 2011 US downgrade and euro debt scare, 2013 taper tantrum in bonds and others): its return, drawdown and worst day in each one its dates fully cover, and the crises it was not there for, listed as untested and never as passed.
tools.args: returns_file: string, drawdown_limit?: number

tools.name: cpcv
tools.title: Combinatorial purged cross-validation
tools.description: Combinatorial purged cross-validation of a search: choose the best trial on training days, score it on held-out blocks, with purge and embargo at the edges, for every choice of blocks, stitched into whole paths. Returns the spread of out-of-sample Sharpes against the in-sample one. Splits can run as shards on other machines and merge back. Paths share days and data, so their spread is not a confidence interval and they are not independent tests.
tools.args: returns_file?: string, groups?: integer, test_groups?: integer, purge_days?: integer, embargo_days?: integer, periods_per_year?: number, shard?: {index,of}, out_file?: string, merge_files?: string[]

tools.name: price_panel
tools.title: Build a price panel
tools.description: Build a price panel from free sources for breadth_book or backtest_signal: the tickers you name or an index fund's current holdings, daily adjusted closes and dollar volume, and each company's Fama-French industry from its SEC SIC code, written as CSV files.
tools.args: tickers?: string[], index_fund?: string, max_names?: integer, start: string, end?: string, out_dir?: string

tools.name: breadth_signals
tools.title: Breadth lab signals
tools.description: The cross-sectional signals breadth_book builds sleeves from: momentum, reversal, low volatility and beta, idiosyncratic risk, lottery demand, skewness, price delay, seasonality and liquidity, each with its formula's source and the data it needs.

tools.name: breadth_book
tools.title: Breadth book of sleeves
tools.description: Build many weakly correlated sleeves (every signal inside every group of names) from your price panel and trade them as one netted account, ALPHAC's breadth lab: rank-weighted within each group, overlapping portfolios, hedged and scaled to a volatility target, costs on actual trades. Returns the book netted and standalone, the netting ratio, effective independent bets and ideas, and writes every sleeve's returns as a training dataset. A sleeve built on many signals and groups is a search: report the number of sleeves, keep a period untouched for the test, and judge the book there, not on the years used to choose it.
tools.args: prices_file: string, groups_file?: string, dollar_volume_file?: string, signals?: string[], min_names?: integer, smoothing?: integer, cost_bps?: number, target_vol?: number, split_date?: string, out_file?: string, ledger?: string

tools.name: breadth_sweep
tools.title: Parallel sweep of breadth settings
tools.description: Run a grid of breadth-book settings (signal sets, smoothing, target volatility, costs, minimum names) in parallel on every core of this machine, or as shards other machines run and merge_files joins. Every combination counts as a trial: the best Sharpe is set against what the best of that many trials reaches by luck, and with split_date the chosen settings are scored after the split.
tools.args: prices_file?: string, groups_file?: string, dollar_volume_file?: string, grid?: {smoothing,target_vol,cost_bps,min_names,signals}, split_date?: string, workers?: integer, shard?: {index,of}, out_file?: string, merge_files?: string[]

tools.name: effective_bets
tools.title: Effective independent bets
tools.description: How many independent bets a set of return series holds: the participation ratio of their weekly correlations (n for unrelated series, 1 for copies), and with families, the families' bets and the ideas they cluster into.
tools.args: returns_file: string, family_separator?: string, threshold?: number

tools.name: annotation_packet
tools.title: Annotation packets
tools.description: Start a labelled dataset: figures (company, measure, period, value) are checked by machine against the SEC filings and written as blind CSV packets for two or more people to label, with guidelines and a key holding the machine labels.
tools.args: task: string, items?: {company,measure,period,value,unit,note}[], items_file?: string, text?: string, company?: string, annotators?: integer, assisted?: boolean, out_dir?: string

tools.name: annotation_agreement
tools.title: Annotation agreement
tools.description: Read filled annotation packets: how often the people agree (Cohen's kappa), how often they agree with the machine, and every disagreement.
tools.args: task_dir: string

tools.name: annotation_gold
tools.title: Annotation gold set
tools.description: Merge filled annotation packets and a reviewer's decisions into a gold dataset (JSONL: each item's label, who decided it, the machine label and source) with a datasheet of agreement and hashes.
tools.args: task_dir: string, reviews?: {item_id,label,correct_value,note}[]

tools.name: enforcement_actions
tools.title: SEC enforcement actions
tools.description: The SEC's latest enforcement: litigation releases and administrative proceedings, with who was named, the number and the document, across the market or filtered to a company or person (every word of the name must match). The feeds hold the latest actions only, so an empty answer is limited to what they reach.
tools.keywords: sec enforcement litigation release administrative proceeding charged fraud settled penalty sanction regulator action against company lawsuit investigation
tools.args: company?: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: consumer_complaints
tools.title: Consumer complaints (CFPB)
tools.description: Complaints consumers sent the CFPB about a bank, lender, card issuer or credit bureau: totals, the last 12 months, top products and issues, and how often the company answered in time. Complaints are unverified and not adjusted for size.
tools.keywords: cfpb consumer complaints bank lender credit card mortgage credit bureau complaint count customer problems regulator
tools.args: company: string

tools.name: product_recalls
tools.title: Product recalls (FDA, NHTSA)
tools.description: Recalls: a firm's FDA recalls of drugs, devices and food with class, reason and status, and a vehicle's NHTSA safety recalls by make, model and year.
tools.keywords: fda recall recalls drug device food class i ii iii nhtsa vehicle car safety defect product recall
tools.args: company?: string, vehicle?: {make,model,year}, limit?: integer

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.title: Sanctions list (OFAC SDN)
tools.description: Search the U.S. Treasury's Specially Designated Nationals list and its aliases for a person, company, bank or vessel, by whole words. Not a compliance screening: no match is not clearance, and a match needs checking against the entry.
tools.keywords: ofac sanctions sdn specially designated nationals sanctioned entity blocked person aml kyc watchlist check screening treasury
tools.args: name: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: federal_rules
tools.title: Federal Register rules
tools.description: Federal Register documents: final and proposed rules, notices and presidential documents by words and agency (SEC, CFTC, Fed, Treasury, CFPB, FDA and more), with comment deadlines, effective dates and abstracts. Can list only rules still open for comment.
tools.keywords: federal register rule rules proposed rulemaking regulation regulations comment period deadline notice agency sec cftc fed effective date policy
tools.args: query?: string, agency?: string, type?: rule|proposed_rule|notice|presidential, since?: string, open_for_comment?: boolean, limit?: integer

tools.name: technical_indicators
tools.title: Technical indicators
tools.description: The common technical indicators for a symbol in one call, from its daily prices: moving averages (SMA and EMA), RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands and ATR, with where the close sits against its 50- and 200-day averages. Standard definitions; describes past prices, not a forecast.
tools.keywords: technical indicators analysis rsi macd bollinger bands moving average sma ema atr golden cross death cross overbought oversold momentum trend chart signals
tools.args: symbol: string, as_of?: string

tools.name: stock_snapshot
tools.title: Analyst targets, valuation and short interest
tools.description: What a quote page shows and no primary source publishes, from Yahoo Finance: analysts' mean, median, high and low price targets, how many analysts, the recommendation and ratings, EPS and revenue estimates by quarter and year, market cap, trailing and forward P/E and other ratios, 52-week range, dividend rate, short interest, institutional and insider percentages, next earnings date. Vendor aggregates, labeled as such; for reported figures use the filings.
tools.keywords: analyst price target consensus mean median recommendation rating ratings buy hold sell estimate estimates eps forecast market cap capitalization pe ratio p/e trailing forward valuation peg beta 52 week high low short interest shares short days to cover institutional ownership insiders held percent float next earnings date quote summary key statistics
tools.args: symbol: string

tools.name: security_identifiers
tools.title: Security identifiers (OpenFIGI)
tools.description: Map a ticker, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL or FIGI to one security through OpenFIGI: its name, FIGIs, listings, exchange and type. Check digits are tested first, so a mistyped ISIN or CUSIP is refused.
tools.keywords: isin cusip sedol figi ticker identifier mapping convert lookup symbol security master openfigi
tools.args: id: string, exchange?: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: legal_entity
tools.title: Legal entity (LEI)
tools.description: Who a company legally is, from the Global LEI register: legal name, LEI, jurisdiction, status, addresses, former names, its direct and ultimate parents and how many entities it owns. By name or LEI; works for firms worldwide, listed or not.
tools.keywords: lei legal entity identifier gleif parent company ownership subsidiary ultimate parent jurisdiction incorporated legal name registered address corporate structure
tools.args: name?: string, lei?: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: world_yields
tools.title: World government yields
tools.description: Government bond yields side by side: U.S. Treasury, euro area (ECB, AAA), UK (Bank of England), Japan (Ministry of Finance) and Canada (Bank of Canada), by maturity, with the date and basis of each curve, 10Y-2Y slopes and 10-year spreads to the U.S.
tools.keywords: global government bond yields bund gilt jgb japan germany euro uk canada sovereign yield curve international compare countries 10 year spread
tools.args: countries?: (us|euro|uk|japan|canada)[]

tools.name: credit_cycle
tools.title: Credit cycle (BIS)
tools.description: The BIS credit cycle by country: private credit as a share of GDP, its long-run trend and the credit-to-GDP gap, an early-warning measure regulators use for banking stress. Up to 40 quarters.
tools.keywords: bis credit to gdp gap credit cycle private debt leverage banking crisis early warning countercyclical buffer country
tools.args: countries: string[], quarters?: integer

tools.name: dividend_history
tools.title: Dividend history
tools.description: A security's dividends and splits: each payment by ex-date, totals by year, the trailing 12-month yield, five-year growth and the streak of rising annual totals. Works for foreign listings.
tools.keywords: dividend dividends history ex-date yield payout growth streak aristocrat splits stock split income per share
tools.args: symbol: string, years?: integer

tools.name: verify_claims
tools.title: Verify claims against filings
tools.description: Check a draft answer's figures against the company's own filings before using them: revenue, net income, EPS, operating income, margins, growth, cash flow, assets, debt and more, for a fiscal year or quarter as the company labels it. US and foreign filers (20-F, IFRS), in their own currency. Each claim comes back confirmed, contradicted (with the filed figure and what the claimed one matches instead: another year, a quarter, a unit slip), not reported or not checkable.
tools.keywords: verify check fact check fact-check confirm validate is this right correct true false hallucination hallucinated accuracy double check numbers figures claims draft answer reported revenue net income eps margin growth source citation
tools.args: company: string, claims?: {measure,period,value,unit,growth,basis}[], text?: string

tools.name: exposure_map
tools.title: Who depends on this company
tools.description: Who depends on a company, from what others say in their annual reports: every filer that names it, with the passage, and whether it reads as a supplier, customer or competitor. For supply chains no fund report shows. Read by rules, so check the passage.
tools.keywords: supply chain who depends on customer supplier exposure reliance competitors mentions of a company in other companies filings tsmc look through relationship network graph
tools.args: name: string, also?: string[], forms?: string[], since?: string, limit?: integer

tools.name: guidance_record
tools.title: Management's record against its own guidance
tools.description: A management team's record against its own word: each quarter it gave guidance in its press release, what it said and what then happened, how often results came in above, within and below its own range, and which quarters fell short.
tools.keywords: promise tracker guidance track record management credibility beat miss range did they hit their guidance sandbag history how often over years
tools.args: company: string, quarters?: integer, measure?: string, filed_before?: string

tools.name: what_happened_next
tools.title: What happened next, every past time
tools.description: Every past time a market or stock fell, rose or sat this far below its high: each case, what followed a month, a quarter and a year later, the worst and best, and how that compares with an ordinary day. A record, not a forecast or advice.
tools.keywords: what happened next last time history analog analogue crash correction bear market drop fall rally after market falls 10 percent should i worry past episodes base rate forward returns
tools.args: symbol?: string, condition: fell|rose|below_high|new_high, percent?: number, days?: integer, horizons?: integer[], since?: string, gap_days?: integer

tools.name: filing_memory
tools.title: Search all of a company's annual reports
tools.description: Everything one company has said about a subject across every annual report it has on EDGAR, back to the 1990s where they exist: the best passages with links, how often it came up each year, and optionally how that moved with a margin, tested against chance. Reads the reports on this machine; no key. Supply the company's likely words in also and all_of, since a company rarely uses yours.
tools.keywords: memory rag semantic search across years decades all 10-k annual reports history every time mentioned said about supply chain risk vector correlate margin dips passages long term company language
tools.args: company: string, query: string, also?: string[], all_of?: string[][], years?: integer, form?: 10-K|20-F|40-F, section?: string, limit?: integer, per_year?: integer, filed_before?: string, correlate_with?: gross_margin|operating_margin|net_margin, semantic?: boolean

tools.name: filing_sentiment
tools.title: Filing tone (local FinBERT)
tools.description: The tone of a filing or any text, sentence by sentence, from FinBERT run on this machine: an 8-K's press release by default, or a 10-K section. Needs the optional local models (canli-mcp models install). Tone, not truth, and no evidence it predicts a price; the model is licensed for non-commercial use.
tools.keywords: finbert sentiment tone deep learning transformer local model 8-k press release positive negative nlp machine learning
tools.args: text?: string, company?: string, accession?: string, form?: string, document?: string, section?: string, max_sentences?: integer

tools.name: shipping_activity
tools.title: Shipping activity (IMF PortWatch)
tools.description: Ships moving through the world's straits and canals (Suez, Panama, Malacca, Hormuz and others) and ports, from the IMF's PortWatch, which estimates them from satellite tracking of ships. All chokepoints against a year ago, one chokepoint by week, or one port. No key.
tools.keywords: alternative data alt satellite ais shipping ships vessels tankers container ports chokepoint suez panama malacca hormuz trade flows logistics supply chain portwatch imf port congestion ports backlog ship traffic
tools.args: chokepoint?: string, port?: string, start?: string, end?: string

tools.name: page_attention
tools.title: Public attention (Wikipedia)
tools.description: Daily Wikipedia page views for a company or subject: a plain measure of public attention, with how the last week compares with normal. No key.
tools.keywords: alternative data alt attention wikipedia page views interest public retail hype popularity trend
tools.args: topic: string, days?: integer

tools.name: latest_price
tools.title: Latest price
tools.description: The latest price of a stock, ETF, index, currency or crypto pair, with the previous close and the time of the price. No key; can run late, by 15 minutes or more on some markets.
tools.keywords: latest last current price quote now today intraday spot how much is what is it trading at right now stock price today how much is
tools.args: symbol: string

tools.name: european_filings
tools.title: European filings (ESEF)
tools.description: A European company's annual financial report as it filed it in the European Single Electronic Format (ESEF): revenue, operating and net profit, EPS, assets, equity, cash, cash flows and dividends as the company tagged them (IFRS concepts, its currency, full scale), with the comparatives, the report's viewer link and the other years on file. Issuers on EU and EEA regulated markets, found by name or LEI; words find any other tagged figure.
tools.keywords: europe european company annual report esef ifrs eu uk france germany netherlands spain italy denmark sweden asml lvmh airbus totalenergies novo nordisk shell sap revenue profit eps balance sheet lei financial statements europe
tools.args: company: string, year?: integer, words?: string

tools.name: reference_rates
tools.title: Reference and policy rates
tools.description: Money-market and policy rates and the ECB's euro exchange reference rates (fx:GBP) from the central banks themselves: SOFR, TGCR, BGCR, EFFR and OBFR from the New York Fed (with percentiles and volume), the euro short-term rate and the ECB's policy rates, SONIA and Bank Rate from the Bank of England, and about forty central banks' policy rates as the BIS collects them (policy:JP, policy:Brazil). Dates and rates, oldest first.

tools.args: rate: string, start?: string, end?: string

tools.name: prediction_markets
tools.title: Prediction markets
tools.description: What traders on Polymarket and Kalshi are paying for an outcome, found by words (a Fed decision, a recession, an election, a price level): each market's probability (the middle of bid and ask, else the last trade), bid, ask, volume and closing date, with the event's resolution rules.
tools.keywords: prediction market polymarket kalshi odds probability betting market implied probability election fed decision recession rate cut forecast market chance will happen
tools.args: query: string, venue?: both|polymarket|kalshi, limit?: integer

tools.name: crypto_fundamentals
tools.title: Crypto fundamentals (DefiLlama)
tools.description: A DeFi protocol's total value locked (now, by chain, and its history), the fees users pay it and the revenue it keeps (24 hours to all time); a chain's total value locked; or a stablecoin's supply in circulation and its change, by chain. From DefiLlama's open data.
tools.keywords: crypto defi tvl total value locked protocol fees protocol revenue defillama stablecoin supply usdt usdc dai chain tvl ethereum solana aave lido uniswap
